All three boxes are children of the same parent (`root`) and are absolutely positioned, meaning they are compared within the same stacking context. The browser determines which element is visible at the overlapping point (120, 120) by comparing their `z-index` values. Since `root>middle` has a `z-index` of 3, which is higher than both `root>front` (2) and `root>back` (1), it is rendered on top of the others.

ANSWER: root>middle
